evidence.detail: OverlayManager maintains this subtype in an int-keyed registry. a(overlay, id) assigns the id to the overlay and stores it under that exact integer key; unregister uses the same stored key.

The manager's a(int,int,int) render entrypoint treats the first integer as the registry key and writes the remaining two integers into the overlay before executing it, matching widget-id plus on-screen x/y rendering.
R205 AdventureBookChapterProgressRenderer extends this class and is registered under exact widget 38388 immediately after the 'Chapter Progress' widget is built.

Other direct subclasses are registered under exact interface/widget ids such as 60065, 32317, 32465 and 32486 by their owning interface builders, confirming this is a generic widget-bound overlay base rather than an Adventure Book special case.

proposals.note: WidgetOverlay is fixed by the exact int-keyed widget registry, x/y dispatch and multiple independent interface-builder registrations. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: R30 independently fixes rs/a/j as Npc and R28 fixes rs/d/d as NpcDefinition. This abstract overlay stores both the live Npc and its NpcDefinition.
The class also stores the current R30 Model and exposes exact NPC hull/polygon geometry helpers computed from the model plus the Npc world coordinates.
OverlayManager's actor-stage dispatch detects this subtype when the supplied actor is rs/a/j, assigns the Npc and current Model, then executes the overlay lifecycle.
Direct subclasses include R208 NpcDefinitionSpriteOverlay plus NPC-facing plugin overlays, all sharing the same Npc/NpcDefinition/Model contract.

proposals.note: NpcOverlay is fixed by exact Npc, NpcDefinition and Model state plus the manager's NPC-specific dispatch. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: R30 independently fixes rs/a/k as Player. This abstract overlay stores exactly one rs/a/k and clears that state after the render lifecycle.
Its protected predicate compares the stored Player directly with Client.eR, the live local-player reference, providing a player-specific self check.
OverlayManager's actor-stage dispatch detects this subtype when the supplied actor is rs/a/k, assigns the Player and executes the overlay lifecycle.
Its exact-v308 direct subclass is the player-facing outline overlay implementation in rs/s/p/b.

proposals.note: PlayerOverlay is fixed by the exact R30 Player type, local-player predicate and player-specific manager dispatch. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: R30 independently fixes rs/a/h as Model. This abstract overlay stores exactly one rs/a/h plus the associated render-context Object and exposes setters for both.
OverlayManager's stage/object/model dispatch detects this subtype, supplies the exact Object plus Model pair, binds the Client and executes the overlay lifecycle for that render stage.
Its only exact-v308 direct subclass is R209 ModelRecoloringOverlay, which consumes the supplied live Model before the item/NPC/object 3D shade stage.

proposals.note: ModelOverlay is fixed by the exact R30 Model type, manager dispatch contract and the ModelRecoloringOverlay specialization. Confidence is 0.999.
